introduction.title: A workspace that adapts to the work.
paragraphs: Modular AI CRM is a configurable CRM concept combining flexible views, dynamic schemas, and AI-assisted actions. It explores how customer workflows can fit different ways of organizing information.

solution.title: The solution
paragraphs: The concept separates the structure of customer information from the way teams view and act on it. Configurable views and dynamic schemas provide flexibility, while AI-assisted actions support work around those records.

capabilities.title: Configurable views
capabilities.description: Organize customer information through views suited to different workflows.

capabilities.title: Dynamic schemas
capabilities.description: Explore adaptable record structures rather than a single fixed customer model.

capabilities.title: AI-assisted actions
capabilities.description: Bring AI assistance into actions around customer information.
